versions.changelog: The API key is now optional to load this skill; with no key, a pointer leads to a temporary free key with no signup and a link the user opens to keep it.
Moves the valuation and growth steps from annual history to quarterly and trailing figures, fixes 13F quarter selection, and treats free-tier previews as partial slices rather than the whole window.

Plain-English output: every verdict opens with a 2-3 sentence bottom line (conclusion, main reason, main risk). Reader-facing labels renamed: Opening cases, Challenges and replies, Their best point, Bottom line, Who disagrees and why, What to watch. Every claim states its fact in words before its evidence citation. Price row labeled as delayed.
Share-count trend reads weightedAverageSharesBasic and weightedAverageSharesDiluted, one basis per window; sharesOutstanding no longer referenced

Fundamentals now route to SentiSense first, with the filings source kept for line-item detail and provenance, plus the two fundamentals calls and their measured field behaviour; removes the npx execution path and declares permissions.
Rewrites the market-insights read against the real response keys so that workflow returns results again.

Resolve-before-fetch paragraph under Authentication (kb/entities/search, first non-null ticker, CLI exit 4 vs quiet REST empties), RESOLVE row in the Fetch Reference, and a Resolve-names-then-fetch Agent Tip.

Sharpen the analyst-consensus price caveat: the snapshot price and the live quote agree exactly right after a refresh and drift between them, so a single sample of the two proves nothing. Adds a same-day matching example alongside the existing gap example.
CLI pin bumped to 0.47.1 (health output no longer echoes key material)
CLI recipes pin 0.46.0.
Corrected award and exercise dollar-value notes in insider tallies.
Pin the CLI to an immutable published version; clarify local key storage is optional and removable
CLI-first workflow fetching with REST fallbacks, Form 4 code F handling, staleness guards

Divergence now requires price and sentiment to move in opposite directions before ranking; same-direction pairs are excluded. Note the millisecond vs second freshness units. Add client identification guidance.
Evidence ledger and pitfalls now state price as 15-minute delayed with priceAsOf, instead of describing it as real time
Description now carries the trigger phrases callers actually search for.
Refreshed workflows against the current API surface, including sector and breadth sentiment.

Fix the thin-sample guard: read properties.directional, the field the Score series actually emits (effectiveMentions was removed and silently read as undefined). Use the new server-side actionTypes filter on analyst activity.
Score wording refresh; add options-positioning evidence to the committee rubric.
Add a thin-sample guard to the divergence screen and restate the congressional disclosure-date caveat.
Accuracy fixes from an independent review: corrected response shapes and field lists, and 429 Retry-After semantics.
Point API-key acquisition at the /get-api-key link (Developer Console for management).

v2 The Investment Committee: thesis questions convene an adversarial panel of investor archetypes that research independently against a shared evidence ledger (sentiment, smart money, SEC fundamentals, macro), cross-examine each other, and deliver a verdict with recorded dissents. Every number cites a ledger row; fail-closed pre-flight gate; works on small local models via structured templates. The five v1 data workflows remain as Quick Reads.

Polish: pre-earnings falls back to the estimates periodLabel when the calendar window is empty; the convergence screen now handles the no-overlap case; the AI-insight headline flags its generatedAt age; sector dedup keeps the higher-scoring GICS variant; documented institutional-holders field names.

Correct response-shape guidance: market-mood nests under market.*; documents/ticker uses published/averageSentiment; analyst estimates under data.estimates[]/data.surprises[]; sentiment scalar at metricValue.value.value; insider transactionType BUY/SELL; calendar/earnings added to wrapped-endpoint list.
Pre-earnings check now sources the next-earnings date from the earnings calendar endpoint instead of asking the user to supply it.
Update API rate limits: PRO tier now unlimited monthly requests (300/min)
Frontmatter: add top-level env requirement declaration to match the ClawScan-validated pattern.
Per-stock insights ranked by importance (relevance, confidence, recency)
Note AGENTS26 builder launch coupon for PRO upgrade.

Accuracy fixes: sentiment is a polarity value in [-1,1] (not a 0-100 scale); explicit wrapped-vs-flat endpoint list; earnings estimates use the surprises history (no revenue or revision fields); 7-day smart-money windows fall back to 30d when empty; chart timeframe=1M returns intraday bars; market-mood sectors is a dict with overlapping labels to dedupe.
Tighten /stocks/descriptions reference in Capability 5 to include the required tickers= query param (per QA-verify followup observation).

Realign endpoint paths and parameters with the live SentiSense API: replace ?period=Nd with startTime/endTime epoch ms windows; rework /insights/market sector-filter claim as client-side; drop /profile next-earnings-date claim; fix tier badge on /insights/stock/{T} (Public preview, not quota-gated); replace 'Bloomberg-style' voice; note /insights/stock/{T}/types is auth-free. Backs out earlier endpoint drift: /insights/stock/{T}/latest -> /insights/stock/{T}; /institutional/top-holdings -> /holders; /analyst/market/activity -> /analyst/activity; days= -> lookbackDays=; /politicians/member/{slug}/trades -> /politicians/member/{slug}. (COMP-541 + COMP-545)
Sync per-minute rate limits with backend (Free 30/min, PRO 200/min).
Add Use & Disclaimer section (educational data interface, not investment advice; user responsible for own decisions; subject to SentiSense API ToS).
Initial release: 5 capability workflows for US equity research (brief, smart-money week, divergence, pre-earnings, sector rotation)
